input.question: Our Cisco edge router has intermittent connectivity failures. What should we order and how do we prevent outages?

technology.answer: Interface modules and power supplies are field-replaceable; failure cause unconfirmed.

output.headline: Diagnose before you buy: confirm the failing component, then replace the interface module and add monitoring.
output.summary: Documentation shows interface modules and power supplies are field-replaceable [EX-T1], but nothing confirms which part failed. Collect diagnostics first so procurement targets the actual fault.

next_actions.action: Pull interface error counters, syslog and temperature readings for the last 30 days
next_actions.why: The failure cause is a hypothesis until diagnostics confirm it

next_actions.action: Stock one spare interface module and enable proactive alerting on interface errors

risks: Replacing hardware without diagnostics may not fix the issue
hypotheses: Overheating or a failing interface module causes the drops
output.uncertainty_note: Root cause is unconfirmed; recommendations are staged so spending follows diagnosis.

output.headline: Proceed with a scanner pilot while building vendor-risk safeguards into the contract.

next_actions.metric: Contract includes SLA and exit terms
